# Simon Plourde — simonplourde.com

> Simon Plourde is a Montreal-based IT professional with 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and Microsoft cloud environments. He writes about technology, AI experiments, finance, and his experiences.

## About

- **Name**: Simon Plourde
- **Location**: Montréal, QC, Canada
- **Current role**: Senior Analyst, Infrastructure & Cybersecurity at Groupe CH
- **Languages**: English, French

## Expertise

- Network infrastructure: firewall (Palo Alto), switching (Cisco, Arista, Ubiquiti), Wi-Fi, VPN, VLAN
- Microsoft cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams
- Systems: Active Directory, ESX/VMware, SAN storage, PowerShell
- Cybersecurity
- Event networking for large-scale venues and festivals (Centre Bell, Place Bell, Jazz de Montréal, Osheaga, IleSoniq)
